{
  "pros": [
    "Simple and intuitive interface for core project management tasks.",
    "Efficient task creation and assignment with inline editing.",
    "Clear visibility of assignees and due dates on task lists.",
    "Easy drag-and-drop reordering of tasks.",
    "Focuses on essential features without overwhelming complexity.",
    "Streamlined communication within projects."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "The free plan is very limited, pushing users to upgrade quickly.",
    "Initial project setup requires manual addition of all tools.",
    "Lack of advanced reporting or approval workflows.",
    "Limited customization options compared to competitors.",
    "Calendar functionality is basic and not well-integrated with all tasks.",
    "Can feel restrictive for complex projects requiring specific integrations."
  ],
  "overall_rating": 4.0
}

pros: Simple and intuitive interface for core project management tasks.
Efficient task creation and assignment with inline editing.
Clear visibility of assignees and due dates on task lists.
Focuses on essential features without overwhelming complexity.
cons: The free plan is very limited, pushing users to upgrade quickly.
Initial project setup requires manual addition of all tools.
Lack of advanced reporting or approval workflows.
Limited customization options compared to competitors.
Calendar functionality is basic and not well-integrated with all tasks.
Can feel restrictive for complex projects requiring specific integrations.
